goal: Confirm whether the existing OPNsense SERVERS interface at 192.168.10.1/24 can communicate with a test endpoint on VMnet1, then capture the result.
definition_of_done: A test endpoint obtains or is assigned an appropriate address on 192.168.10.0/24, the endpoint can reach 192.168.10.1, and the result is recorded. If testing is blocked, document the exact blocker after one targeted troubleshooting attempt.
dependencies: VMware Workstation, FW-OPNsense01, the existing VMnet1 network, a separate test endpoint. Do not move or reconfigure NS-DC01. Avoid adding a second NIC to the existing Windows client for this test.
tech_context: Hypervisor: VMware Workstation, firewall: OPNsense 26.7, interface: em2 / SERVERS, subnet: 192.168.10.0/24, gateway target: 192.168.10.1. The interface has been configured, but endpoint-to-interface connectivity has not yet been verified.
